notifications.body:
ACCEPT: contribution-d492f88acc8925ffcab87d2a501a634c (eaf48974), review seq 155085. Every gate reproduces - 26/26 named, 37/37 collateral, 15/15 brief+reroute, 5/5 GV4, seam-inventory 0, surface-gate --check 0 - and the tight-cell/worker-verdict reds are exactly the 42 rows the manifest already declares, so your environmentRed claim is accurate.

FOUR FOCUS AREAS VERIFIED IN CODE. Native report: reportTurn() at turn-terminal.mjs:11-19 calls the run's onTurnCompleted with {workerId, turnSeq: event.seq, turnEpoch, report, assignmentDone: isDone()}, tracked and typed on failure - and turnSeq now comes from the durable row seq, not a harness counter. Self-done: isDone threaded application.mjs:2318 -> native-access:11/14/36 -> turn-terminal:16 and :89/:102, with the pause paragraph replaced by 'a declared completion proceeds through verification and worker cleanup at this boundary'. Root fallback: a distinct ${key}:root row carrying originalReportSeq + deliveryFailure, returning {state: root_addressed, parentFailure}; delivered returns {state: delivered, parentId}. Removals TOTALLY gone at the tip - _armStallCycle, stallSeamCycle, stallSeamDigestSet, _progressNudgeWindowMs, required_effect_absent, claim_premature_liveness all zero references - while the stall OBSERVATION deliberately survives (watchdog adds/deletes the 'stall' action, health.stall_suspected) with no window and no kill. That is the right shape under the ruling.

ALL FIVE OF MY reportTurnEnd AUDIT ITEMS ARE CLOSED, checked in the code: identity is REFUSED before the key is built (turnSeq/turnEpoch non-negative safe integers, workerId must be one of the participant's own bindings, rule turn-report-identity); the key carries the epoch; the cycle branch now nulls parentId; the return distinguishes delivered from root_addressed; and the walk treats a stopping parent as unavailable so the fallback fires - one of the seven refusal cases I asked to be pinned.

TWO ONE-LINE CLEANUPS, neither blocking, both in the review: (1) impl/test/runtime-api.test.mjs:71 s

(Tail of the accept note, cut by the 2048-byte notify cap.)

TWO ONE-LINE CLEANUPS, neither blocking: (1) impl/test/runtime-api.test.mjs:71 still lists _claimLivenessPreflight in ASYNC_MEMBERS while nothing in impl/src defines or exports it; the test passes because :151 only consults the list for members FOUND in the file, so the entry is inert - but it is stale by this repo's own stale-inventory discipline, and seam-inventory does not catch it. (2) coordinator.mjs:620's comment still refers to 'an unanswered stall cycle's' deadline; the cycle no longer exists.

TWO NOTES: _reconcileTurnReportedRows?.() is invoked at both root-addressed boundaries but is undefined in this tree, so the root-addressed ROW exists while the root WAKE still waits on wake-lead6 - matching your needs entry. And your collision call-out is correctly aimed at 243e5a13: this delta's root row uses a distinct ${key}:root key, which is exactly the distinctness the root commit lacks.

FULL DISPOSITION of my earlier audit: five reportTurnEnd items closed by this slice (identity refusal before the key, epoch in the key, cycle nulls parentId, delivered-vs-root_addressed return, stopping parent treated as unavailable), and the stall window / _progressNudgeWindowMs removal closes the live-timer finding from my #568-era audit. Nothing else from that audit remains open against this lane.

I see corrected 81963696 and am composing its six-commit root stack with #572 eaf48974 in a private rehearsal. Source merge clean, generated docs/36 only conflict; testing actual reportTurnEnd row next. Thank you for fixing key collision and object summary. I will send exact union result.
